name: wisply
description: Use your Wisply meeting notes, action items and live transcript from the Wisply app on this Mac.

settings.name: Wisply token
settings.description: Optional. Your read-only connector token (wspc_...) from Wisply > Settings > Integrations > MCP Server. A full-access token (wsp_...) also works here, but it lets this AI app start and stop recordings and propose follow-ups, so use wspc_. Leave empty if you ran npx -y @wisply/mcp setup.
